entries.wording: Order created by BNE1 to be collected
entries.note: EWE has the order and waits to collect the parcel; BNE1 names the Brisbane depot, so the wording changes with the depot.

entries.wording: Parcel arrived at warehouse BNEDC-1. We will deliver within 3 working days
entries.note: First scan in EWE's Brisbane warehouse; the warehouse name changes with the site. The tracking page's lookup relays it cut after the first sentence.

entries.wording: Parcel has left warehouse BNEDC-1. Our driver will deliver your parcel to you.
entries.note: The parcel left the warehouse with the driver who delivers it. The wording names the driver after "Our driver"; the adapter drops the name.

entries.wording: The parcel has been delivered. If not, please contact amazon.delivery@ewe.com.au and we will deal with it as soon as possible.
entries.note: The delivery of an Amazon-channel parcel.
Delivery with a proof-of-delivery photo, a moment after sign_in.
collect_order as the tracking page's lookup relays it, without a code.
The first scan of an eMetro consignment.
eMetro, EWE's delivery arm, collected the consignment from the warehouse.
The consignment was assigned to a delivery run, days before it went out.
Loaded for the delivery run, under an hour before On Delivery.
eMetro closes the consignment hours after its delivery scan; it moves nothing.
